title: Geologic map of the Pritchardville quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2002, Geologic map of the Pritchardville quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-1, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 1 is the map sheet; pages 2-4 are unrelated symbol-style notes appended to the download and were not read for values. Map symbols are assigned from the description boxes (viewed on page images), flagged inferred. Section A-A' read from page-image tiles: hole positions along the section are not recorded because the section prints no horizontal scale; contacts between holes not recorded. Hole intervals are elevations read off the feet scale (below-sea-level labels are printed without a minus sign; recorded negative). 7-252 is drawn from above the profile (no land-surface elevation). Many drill-hole labels on the map face (7-209 to 7-259, 27-107 to 27-111) have no printed locations and were not recorded. Bottom of drill holes is base of cross section.
